title: Invariant manifolds and transversality for a traveling-wave ODE in a controlled reaction-diffusion model
summary: We study the parameter dependence and transversality properties of trajectories of the controlled ODE $$ U_x = P, \qquad P_x = - f(U) - βP + \tilde α(x)U, $$ arising from traveling-wave solutions of a bistable reaction-diffusion equation with control. Optimal profiles minimizing the $L^1$-norm of the control $\tilde α$ are determined by the unstable and stable manifolds $Γ_u$, $Γ_s$, the critical curve $$ P^*(U) = \sqrt{Uf(U)}, $$ and the associated function $$ F(U) = \frac{dP^*}{dU} + \frac{f(U)}{P^*(U)}. $$ We establish generic transversality properties for these objects with respect to…
